description: `ovld status-line` answers from local state only: an unbound session reads no cache, spawns nothing and makes no network call, and a stale snapshot starts one detached, lock-guarded refresh. The refresh uses only side-effect-free reads (display-id mission search, the mission's objectives, the objective's open agent requests). It never reads `GET /api/missions/:id`, which marks the mission's blocking-question indicator seen, and never writes to stderr.
